extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: For a diagnosis of hyperthyroidism and a diagnosis of pregnancy or post-partum, testing for antithyroglobulin antibody (TgAb) (CPT code 86800) IS REIMBURSABLE.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: For a diagnosis of hypothyroidism or hyperthyroidism without a diagnosis of autoimmune thyroid disease, for example, Hashimoto disease, Graves' disease, testing for thyroid antibodies (CPT code 83519, CPT code 83520, CPT code 84445, CPT code 86376, CPT code 86800) IS REIMBURSABLE once every three years.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: For thyroid cancer, testing for serum thyroglobulin TgAb (CPT code 84432) and TgAb levels (CPT code 86800) IS REIMBURSABLE.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: For all other situations not described above, testing for TgAb levels (CPT code 86800), thyroid-stimulating immunoglobulins (CPT code 84445) and serum thyroglobulin (CPT code 84432) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: Testing for thyroxine-binding globulin (TBG) (CPT code 84442), thyrotropin-releasing hormone (TRH) (CPT code 80438, CPT code 80439) or reverse triiodothyronine (T3) (CPT code 84482) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

extracted_content.title: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.hierarchy_path: Medicare Advantage Payment Policy
extracted_content.content: Testing for thyroxine (CPT code 84437) over the age of two IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

reimbursement_guidelines.title: Reimbursement Guidelines
reimbursement_guidelines.content:
As a Medicare Advantage plan, we have developed payment policies to explain coverage more fully for services. The criteria outlined will apply to Medicare Advantage plans except when the procedure(s) has established criteria through the Original Medicare National Coverage Determinations (NCDs) and Local Coverage Determinations (LCDs) as outlined below. In addition to the policy, claims payments are subject to other plan requirements for the processing and payment of claims, including, but not limited to, requirements of medical necessity and reasonableness and applicable referral or authorization requirements.

For a diagnosis of hyperthyroidism and a diagnosis of pregnancy or post-partum, testing for antithyroglobulin antibody (TgAb) (CPT code 86800) IS REIMBURSABLE.

For a diagnosis of hypothyroidism or hyperthyroidism without a diagnosis of autoimmune thyroid disease, for example, Hashimoto disease, Graves' disease, testing for thyroid antibodies (CPT code 83519, CPT code 83520, CPT code 84445, CPT code 86376, CPT code 86800) IS REIMBURSABLE once every three years.

For thyroid cancer, testing for serum thyroglobulin TgAb (CPT code 84432) and TgAb levels (CPT code 86800) IS REIMBURSABLE.

For all other situations not described above, testing for TgAb levels (CPT code 86800), thyroid-stimulating immunoglobulins (CPT code 84445) and serum thyroglobulin (CPT code 84432) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Testing for thyroxine-binding globulin (TBG) (CPT code 84442), thyrotropin-releasing hormone (TRH) (CPT code 80438, CPT code 80439) or reverse triiodothyronine (T3) (CPT code 84482) IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.

Testing for thyroxine (CPT code 84437) over the age of two IS NOT REIMBURSABLE.
